newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Ssangyong to invest 1.8 trln won by 2006.
newsitem.headline: Ssangyong to invest 1.8 trln won by 2006.

text.p: Ssangyong Corp, a unit of South Korea's Ssangyong Group, said on Monday it planned to invest 1.8 trillion won by 2006.
The company targets turnover of 17 trillion won in 2001 and 50 trillion in 2006, Ssangyong said in a statement.
Ssangyong posted sales of 5.24 trillion won in 1995.
The statement said the investment mostly would be spent on telecommunications, plant projects, natural resource development and distribution.
Ssangyong said the aim of the investment plan was to diversify away from trading.
